device: 450 mm class quadcopter on Pixhawk 6C / PX4
task: Develop a practical, non-flight-authorizing quadcopter assembly concept from a documented flight controller; enumerate required complete subsystem interfaces and missing sizing calculations.

intake.goal: Develop a buildable quadcopter design using documented Pixhawk 6C flight controller and PX4; identify frame motors propellers ESC power distribution battery radio GPS firmware and setup; check interface/power compatibility and missing thrust/weight/current measurements before any operation.

claims: Pixhawk 6C POWER1 and POWER2 require regulated supply through suitable power module
Pixhawk 6C supports PWM servo outputs and PX4 multicopter configurations
Pixhawk 6C supports power module, GPS/compass and ESC interface wiring

deliverables: exact controller power-rail design and isolation
four motor ESC battery sizing table
thrust to weight calculations and expected current
PX4 configuration and bench-only validation protocol
acceptance: Do not wire battery directly to flight-controller regulated POWER port
No assumed thrust or runtime without motor prop battery data
